root_cause: The website risk classifier treated the entire .github/workflows/ directory as a high-risk website artifact even though workflow definitions are delivery control-plane source. This caused workflow-only changes to install Playwright and crawl every public route across three viewports.
prevention: Classify .github/workflows/ as non-artifact website control plane. Runtime website artifacts such as menu JavaScript and netlify.toml remain high-risk and retain exact-preview browser verification.

evidence.observed_tail: Workflow-only PR #3886 reached full standalone public-route visibility verification despite no website runtime artifact change.
evidence.preserved_gate: Website baseline and syntax-preflight remain required for control-plane lane execution.
